strings.text: A garden over night water at the edge of an empire that is ending. An old khan at his chessboard, a traveller who tells him cities, a ship waiting for dawn.
strings.translation: Un jardin au-dessus de l’eau nocturne, au bord d’un empire qui finit. Un vieux khan devant son échiquier, un voyageur qui lui raconte des villes, un navire qui attend l’aube.
